determinism.atomicity: The output parent must already exist and the output directory must not. No parent is created by the renderer. Every parent component is opened from the filesystem root with O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW before mutation; the held parent fd is identity-checked before staging, immediately before rename, and after rename. Staging and every output file are exclusively created relative to held directory fds, fsynced, and published with Linux renameat2 RENAME_NOREPLACE within the same held parent fd. A post-rename identity failure is rolled back through that fd before staging cleanup. Parent swaps and symlink ancestors fail without publishing or escaped residue. Random staging identifiers and absolute input/output paths never enter published bytes.
determinism.inventory: render_receipt.json has a closed top-level and nested schema, signs the exact relative-path, byte-count, and SHA-256 inventory of all SVGs, and uses payload_sha256 as its self-binding. The staged on-disk receipt is reloaded and required to equal the in-memory receipt before publication.
determinism.source_binding: Let P be the publication_source_commit in the compiler receipt and S be the renderer checkout HEAD. Before import, the renderer requires the canonical compiler to equal both the receipt descriptor and pinned trusted SHA-256 1a76b0b78eb2a5dec74c220865450946f4a07731376fbeb4d80912884368bec8. It then reuses that compiler's pinned-system-Git, sanitized-environment, literal-HTTPS isolated graph to prove P <= S <= stable refs/heads/codex/forecast-layout-gm-20260912. Compiler bytes must match at P and S, and exact renderer plus contract bytes must match their Git blobs at S. S and the authenticated control receipt are signed into render_receipt.json. Authentication and all input hashes repeat immediately before the atomic no-replace rename.

figures.actual_scene_layouts.svg: All 24 original/reflected layout pairs use one shared x-y projection of the exact robot-base-metre positions. Exact x, y, z and quaternion source values are retained in marker titles; z is also printed beside every marker. No yaw or unrecorded camera geometry is inferred.
figures.forecast_skill_MODEL.svg: One file per included model, showing only the signed forecast-skill-versus-persistence estimate, CI, and exact per-layout input values. Excluded layouts remain explicitly not estimable.
figures.qualified_timing.svg: For each included model, generated_frame_index, primary_horizon_s, target_executed_action_offset, executed_prefix_cap, camera_id, and timestamp_tolerance_s are printed exactly. The three target domains use separate schematic tracks with no shared numerical scale or inferred conversion.
figures.reflection_layout_effects_MODEL.svg: One file per included model, showing signed per-command actual, predicted, and discrepancy contrasts, the combined discrepancy, and exact per-layout discrepancy inputs. Null metrics remain explicitly not estimable.

cross_bindings: forecast and scene inputs bind the same final_analysis SHA-256 as build_receipt.json
scene input binds the same confirmation_fixture_freeze SHA-256 as build_receipt.json
the build receipt output inventory exactly binds every file in the immutable publication directory
study, branch, included model order, layout count, bootstrap identity, and source-only boundary agree across inputs

presentation_transforms_only: finite robot-base x-y coordinates are linearly projected onto a shared SVG display domain
already-computed estimates, intervals and per-layout values are linearly projected onto SVG display axes
source scalar values are serialized into visible text or marker titles without changing the underlying input
